name: codexstyle-assistant
description: Connect Codex to CodexStyle for safe theme discovery and palette drafting.

interface.shortDescription: Generate safe CodexStyle theme drafts with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Read the local CodexStyle theme library, validate complete color systems, derive non-destructive drafts, and select reviewed themes for the next Codex launch.
defaultPrompt: 基于当前 CodexStyle 主题生成一套现代奢华配色草稿。
检查当前主题的文字对比度并新建一个改进草稿。
列出 CodexStyle 主题并选择我指定的已保存主题。
